title: Federated Identity: one platform-issued credential, three services
lede: The platform issues the workload a short-lived token. The gateway checks it against the issuer's key set and the identity's exact binding, then calls the backend with the application's own credential: the token stops at the gateway. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

steps.title: Token issued
steps.what: The platform issues the workload a short-lived token. Nothing long-lived is stored in the workload.

steps.title: Token presented
steps.what: The workload presents it. The same identity can reach MCP, A2A and LLM; only the scopes on the key differ.

steps.title: Key set
steps.what: The gateway holds the issuer's key set, refreshes it every fifteen minutes and on an unknown signing key, and keeps the last known good set through an outage.

steps.title: Exact binding
steps.what: Issuer, subject and audience match exactly, expiry is required and the lifetime is capped.

steps.title: Backend isolation
steps.what: The backend receives the application's own configured credential. The workload token is never forwarded.

steps.title: Attribution
steps.what: Every request is attributed to a specific deployment, and revoking the identity cuts the workload off at once.
